issues.title: sortedByRef keeps input order, which may be unsorted or contain duplicates
issues.evidence: sortedByRef = append(sortedByRef, ref)  // input from index.NewListPostings(seriesRefs) in CompactSelectedSeries
issues.failure_scenario: A caller passes refs [5,3] or [3,3] to CompactSelectedSeries. NewListPostings then holds an unsorted list, so Intersect in the reader gives wrong results, and a duplicate ref leads to duplicate series in sortedByLabels, which makes the block index writer fail with an out-of-order series error.
